scenarios.title: A maintainer reads each persona's scenarios beside the changes

steps.text: The maintainer opens a proposal from a link; the bar shows its title, its source and its counts.
The review column docks beside the map: Changes, then Personas and scenarios, both open.
The scenarios are grouped by the persona that acts in each; those that name none are under Anyone, and the personas in none are named.
The maintainer opens one scenario: its steps are checked in one batch and read Allowed, Refused or Not checked.
Choosing step 2 opens the player paused there, and the camera puts the step's node in the free map, labelled.

scenarios.title: A maintainer reviews a whole proposal with a screen reader, without the canvas

steps.text: Opening the proposal is announced with its title and counts; the title is a heading.
Heading by heading: Changes as a list, then each persona as a heading with its scenarios as a list.
A scenario expands to an ordered list; each step says who acts, the node, its mark, the text and the verdict.
Choosing a step keeps focus on it; the player's polite line says the same step.
The decision is the column's last group: the line about what Approve does, Send back, Approve.

scenarios.title: An agent writes a scenario with no persona and is told while drafting

steps.text: The agent runs cornfield proposal on its draft, as CONTRIBUTING asks.
The proposal is valid, with one warning: a scenario names no persona and will be listed under Anyone.
The agent names one of the map's personas as the scenario's actor and runs the check again.
